fn can_arrange(arr: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires forall i in 0..len(arr): forall j in (i + 1)..len(arr): (arr[i] != arr[j])
  ensures ((result == -1) or ((0 < result) and (result < len(arr))))
  ensures ((not (result == -1)) or (forall i in 1..len(arr): (arr[i] >= arr[(i - 1)])))
  ensures ((not (result != -1)) or ((((1 <= result) and (result < len(arr))) and (arr[result] < arr[(result - 1)])) and (forall j in (result + 1)..len(arr): (arr[j] >= arr[(j - 1)]))))
  ensures ((not (result != -1)) or (exists i in 1..len(arr): (arr[i] < arr[(i - 1)])))
  effects pure
  example (can_arrange([]) == 0)
{
  0
